# Ethiopia

The wealth gradients this library holds for Ethiopia: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −0.74 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2024 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **−0.66** | DHS 2024 |
| `mort_gradient` | **0.09** (ages 15–60) | census 2007, own measurement |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.51 | −0.84 | −0.53 | −0.41 | −0.64 | −1.13 | −1.72 |

> **Note.** The 2007 census links only 100% of deaths to household assets: the tilt is usable, the death-rate levels are not.

## Where these numbers come from

### Household surveys (DHS)

Latest survey, from [`data/gradient_library_latest.csv`](../../data/gradient_library_latest.csv). Earlier surveys are in `gradient_library.csv`.

| Measure | Survey | Tilt | Poorest ÷ richest tenth | Poorest fifth → richest fifth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Births per woman (TFR) | 2024 | **−0.74** | 2.0× | 5.7 · 4.4 · 4.2 · 3.9 · 2.9 |
| Infant deaths per 1,000 births (IMR) | 2024 | **−0.66** | 1.8× | 48 · 36 · 51 · 33 · 26 |
| Under-5 deaths per 1,000 births (U5MR) | 2024 | **−0.70** | 1.9× | 65 · 48 · 66 · 43 · 34 |

### Adult mortality from censuses

Tilts of the death rate across household wealth, from [`data/adult_mortality_gradients.csv`](../../data/adult_mortality_gradients.csv) ([method](../methods/adult-mortality.md)). Men and women together where available; the by-sex rows are in the [full table](../tables/adult_mortality.md). A blank cell had too few deaths to publish.

| Census | Ages 15–60 | 15–29 | 30–44 | 45–59 | 60–74 | Wealth groups | Deaths |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2007 | **0.09** | −0.87 | 0.08 | 0.58 | 0.44 | 3 | 4,329 |

Source: IPUMS International (Ruggles et al., doi:10.18128/D020.V7.7); original data: Central Statistical Agency, Ethiopia.

## Notes

- The 2007 census asks assets and mortality of the long-form 20% subsample only; its weights already inflate to national totals — do not re-scale. 46% of persons hold no assets, so the asset distribution supports only three wealth groups (`groups` column).
- Ethiopia is the flattest adult gradient in the library (45q15 tilt ≈ +0.09, i.e. no protective wealth gradient), and at 30+ the measured gradient turns positive — see the older-age reversal discussion in the general-gradient page before using the older bands.
